title: Peer listening sheet with the rubric
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Ash-Sharh, Ad-Duha 1 to 8 and applying the rules
source: Seeded from quran/y3 lesson 39 (Pupil PDF worksheet: peer listening sheet with the rubric)
intro: Lesson 39: Peer listening: Ash-Sharh and Ad-Duha 1 to 8. To understand how to listen to a partner's recitation, notice a mistake and help kindly

questions.q: Teacher and a volunteer show a peer-listening turn with Ash-Sharh 1 to 4.
questions.a: Volunteer recites; teacher gives one kind tip.
questions.model: I do: I listen with the mushaf, wait to the end of the ayah, then say: 'MashaAllah, clear ghunnah; check the ب at «فَٱنصَبْ».'

questions.q: Pairs: each recites Ash-Sharh and Ad-Duha 1 to 8 to a partner, who gives one tip. The teacher listens to today's rota group.
questions.a: Both pupils recite; tips recorded in the revision log.
questions.model: The teacher joins the first pair.

questions.q: recite At-Tin to your partner too.
Back to our ponder: If your friend makes a mistake while reciting, what is the kindest way to help?
questions.a: Wait until the end of the ayah, then say the correct word gently, and praise what they did well.
